sql: select relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) size, heap_blks_read, heap_blks_hit, idx_blks_read, idx_blks_hit, n_tup_ins, seq_scan, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze, (select stats_reset from pg_stat_database where datname=current_database()) stats_reset, (select setting||unit from pg_settings where name='shared_buffers') shared_buffers from pg_statio_user_tables join pg_stat_user_tables using (relid, schemaname, relname) order by pg_total_relation_size(relid) desc limit 12
